subject: Urban Planning
title: The Urban Century: 70% by 2050
description: A fast breakdown of The Urban Century: 70% by 2050 for builders.

hook.text: In 2007, more people lived in cities than the countryside for the first time in human history. By 2050, it will be 70%.

buildup.text: That means 2.5 billion more urban residents in 30 years. We need to build the equivalent of a new city every week.

discovery.text: Most growth will happen in Africa and Asia — Lagos, Dhaka, and Kinshasa could each hold 30 million people by mid-century.

twist.text: These cities are growing faster than they can build infrastructure. Many new residents arrive in informal settlements.

climax.text: How these cities grow — planned or chaotic, dense or sprawling — will determine the planet's environmental future.

punchline.text: A new city every week for 30 years. That's the challenge ahead.

quiz.question: What percentage of the world population will live in cities by 2050?
